name: AIQueueBadge
description: Compact status badge for a single item in an AI execution queue. Pairs contextual icon with status label and optional count bubble.
intent: Show queue state (queued, running, blocked, needs-approval, complete) with accessible color and icon coding in dense layouts.

requiredAttributes: aria-label derived from label or default status string

usage: Show queue state on a single pipeline item inside queue cards, sidebars, or table rows
Communicate dense status at a glance — icon + label + optional count
Pair with queue list patterns where multiple items need independent status coding
doNotUse: General-purpose status chips unrelated to execution queues — use appropriate domain badge
Interactive status toggles — badge is display-only; use controls for state changes
Long descriptive text — keep labels short; use tooltips or detail panels for prose
Do not use as an interactive button or toggle
Do not hardcode brand hex — use AI tokens and CSS vars
Do not invent status icons — use bundled SVG icons verbatim
